bluf: Coalition Technologies is a Los Angeles SEO and web design agency, 250+ team members by its homepage meta, ownership not disclosed, selling organic and AI search visibility first, with local SEO, Google and ChatGPT Ads, web builds and email behind them. The record shows it going all in on AI search: a flagship AI SEO menu, an AI Visibility Framework, and 2025 and 2026 Clutch badges as a top GEO company. A rival should know it practises what it sells on its own house (2 of 2 tested lines), yet 15 of 18 clients on record are names only and its sitemap shows 0 updates in 90 days.
doing:
The positioning line, a Los Angeles SEO and web design agency promising revenue from Google and AI search, plus PPC, email and social, on month to month contracts, decodes as a volume performance shop selling the search result, organic and generative, and the site behind it. The headline claim, quoted as a claim, is 687% more revenue than the average agency, citing 860+ case studies and 7.2M+ leads; the homepage also cites 4.8 ratings on Google (250+ reviews) and Clutch (160+ reviews), and the markup lists dozens of Clutch, Manifest and UpCity awards from 2019 to 2026.

Two lead lines score 3: AI Search / GEO (an AI SEO menu with ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews pages, the AI Visibility Framework, Sugatsune and P3 AI SEO cases) and SEO (title, H1 and meta brand it the top rated SEO company, 800+ case studies cited). Three core lines score 2: Local (14 city SEO landing pages), Paid Search (Google Ads, Enterprise PPC and ChatGPT Ads pages) and Web & Product (web design on Shopify, Magento and headless, a claim of 800+ sites built, the Native Union case). Partners on record: Google Premier Partner (2026), Shopify Premier Partner, Meta Marketing Partner, Microsoft Advertising Partner (2026), Klaviyo Master Platinum Partner.

AI posture: AI SEO/GEO is the flagship, covering ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews optimization, ChatGPT Ads and shopping guidance, and AI development work; the Horus move read marks P1 partial because no audited AI visibility product shows. Pricing signals: month to month contracts, free strategy review and proposal offers, a portfolio title referencing SEO pricing; the move read still finds no public pricing model. Dated moves: 2025 Top Clutch SEO company (US) and Top Generative Engine Optimization company; 2026 Clutch badges including Top GEO company; case studies with lastmod dates from 2026-02-17 to 2026-03-26. Conspicuously absent: a data and measurement line (score 0), jobs, and news beyond badges.
clients:
The record describes a mixed client type across verticals from fashion and beauty, jewelry and health and wellness to legal, dental, finance and home and garden, with Los Angeles as home market; the book on record is 18 names, 3 observed and 15 named only, the observed mix organic demand 0.581, paid performance 0.194, then web build, CRM and local.

The observed three: Microsoft came for organic demand and paid performance (N1, N2) on the title SEO & PPC Case Study for Microsoft Bing Enterprise Maps; Roku for organic, paid and CRM (N1, N2, N6) on SEO & Email Marketing Campaign Results; Sugatsune America for organic, web build and local (N1, N4, N10) on BigCommerce B2B and B2C web design and development, SEO and Local SEO for Sugatsune America; two named only clients carry evidence in the capability notes, P3 America as an AI SEO case and Native Union as the web design case. Spiceology, Pink Lily, Urban Armor Gear, 1ink, Lease Advisors, Enjuku Racing, Asphalt Kingdom, Rescue Restoration, Metarom USA, Army Surplus World, Seidel Exterior Group, Traliant and Ramos Law Group are names with no described work, needs inferred from the SEO led mix.

Microsoft also sits on the books of code-and-theory, instrument, aimclear and billion-dollar-boy; 15 of 18 are names only, which the openings read flags as thin evidence.

As a judgment, the Horus read places the agency best for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) and KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) through SEO hours; its ecommerce and local clients are likely to ask for a citation number and for measurement next, and the record shows neither an audited AI visibility product nor a data line; moderate confidence.

openings:
The strongest opening is the gap between flagship and proof: it sells AI SEO/GEO as its lead line, with badges as a top GEO company, but no audited AI visibility product (citation share, scorecard, tracking) shows in its record, so a rival leading with the audited number is likely to win the AI search conversation (moderate confidence: the record may undercount). Falsifier: a published citation share or scorecard product on coalitiontechnologies.com at the next compile.

It runs paid media without first party data, creative volume or measurement depth showing, and has no data line at all, so the inputs the platforms consume are the pitch against its Google and ChatGPT Ads work (likely). No feed, schema or entity work shows despite Shopify and Magento builds. Pricing is half public, month to month contracts and a pricing title but no model, so a rival publishing outcome pricing takes the transparency claim further. Monsoon reads Onshore wind at 62.9 with displacement 64.4, so the book buys on price and an offshore delivered SEO and web offer very likely undercuts it line by line. Microsoft already shops with four other tracked agencies, and 15 of 18 clients are names only, questions to ask.
